topic: Personas, Empathy Maps, and User Needs
learningObjectives: Create a basic persona from user research findings.
Identify what users say, think, feel, and do using an empathy map.
Convert research observations into actionable user needs.

activities.title: Persona Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the key parts of a UX persona.

content.concept: A persona summarizes a representative user's goals, behaviors, needs, frustrations, and context.

activities.title: Build a Persona
activities.instruction: Assemble a persona from research evidence.

content.concept: Personas should be grounded in research rather than assumptions and should represent meaningful user patterns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Empathy Map Explorer
activities.instruction: Place each observation in the correct empathy-map section.

content.concept: Empathy maps organize what users say, think, do, and feel to reveal patterns in their experience.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

content.concept: A user need should be supported by evidence and describe what helps users achieve their goals.
